name: Lone square pier 901
prompt: a freestanding fragment of a stone aqueduct, one arch on weathered piers with a broken water channel on top, lone square pier, tall, about two people high, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: Render the sprite scaled so its height == world_px_height; a character is character_height_px tall.

recovered_spec: metadata restored by replaying run 5's deterministic planner at its checkout (a21c4bc8); orphan creation order matched the planned sequence exactly

LIT_2.glow_concept: soulstone veins glowing through cracked masonry

motion.description: This is an almost completely still picture. ONLY the outermost edge of the single brightest cyan crack changes, and barely: a few pixels along that edge lift very slightly in brightness and drop straight back. Every other crack in the stone stays exactly as it is. The crack stays exactly the cyan it is in the first frame and is equally visible in every frame. Frames 1, 2 and 5 are identical to each other. Only frames 3 and 4 differ at all, and only by a handful of pixels. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel. The last frame matches the first exactly.
